title: Glowing wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wrist strap upper -->
  <path d='M38 10 Q50 4 62 10 L62 26 Q50 22 38 26 Z' fill='#7b4a2d'/>
  <path d='M38 10 Q50 4 62 10 L62 14 Q50 8 38 14 Z' fill='#a06a42'/>
  <!-- wrist strap lower -->
  <path d='M38 74 Q50 78 62 74 L62 90 Q50 96 38 90 Z' fill='#7b4a2d'/>
  <path d='M38 86 Q50 92 62 86 L62 90 Q50 96 38 90 Z' fill='#a06a42'/>
  <!-- buckle hint -->
  <rect x='44' y='90' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c8c0b0'/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#3a3f4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='23' fill='#5a6270'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#0d1b2a'/>
  <!-- glowing rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#4fd8ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='74' y='46' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#c8c0b0'/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <g fill='#4fd8ff'>
    <rect x='49' y='32' width='2' height='4' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='49' y='64' width='2' height='4' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='32' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='64' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='40' y2='42' stroke='#7ef0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='58' y2='35' stroke='#c8fbff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- second hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='50' y2='34' stroke='#ff8ad8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff8ad8'/>
  <!-- glow sparkle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#4fd8ff' opacity='0.08'/>
</svg>
